title: fix(scripts): decide alternate-format from the manifest, not the filesystem
body:
Fixes #9124

One case in `scripts/__tests__/check-side-effects-array.test.ts` changed verdict with the tree's BUILD STATE. `classifyEntryForms` decided whether a published form was an `asset` or an `alternate-format` by calling `existsInPackage` (`fs.existsSync`), so `@object-ui/layout`'s `require` half — `./dist/index.umd.cjs`, the only second build format in the entire array-declaring population — classified as an alternate format on an unbuilt tree and as an `asset` on a built one. `alternateFormats` went 1 to 0 and the real-workspace case red with `expected 0 to be greater than 0`. `git check-ignore -v` answers `.gitignore:6:dist`, so **the input the assertion turned on was never in the tree at all**.

Being a second build format is a fact about the **declaration** — conditions below a subpath choose a format, not an entry — so it is now decided from the manifest's structure, before the filesystem is consulted. `existsInPackage` is **unchanged and keeps both call sites**.

Base measured: `3bc1bb4903`. Head `9fcd786c77`; test and gate figures below from `5b95531028` and re-confirmed unchanged on `9fcd786c77` (that commit is comments only).

## Why not simply drop the filesystem question

Measured first, by two-way ablation of `return fs.existsSync(abs) && fs.statSync(abs).isFile();`. Forcing it to `true` reds **4** cases, and two of them do not go quiet — the dangling form is promoted to a graph root and the walk crashes:

```
 FAIL  ... > refuses a form it cannot classify rather than skipping it
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '.../packages/pkg/dist/ghost.js'
 ❯ scanModule scripts/check-side-effects-array.mjs:687:8
 FAIL  ... > refuses a subpath PATTERN, which names no single file
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '.../packages/pkg/dist/*.js'
```

Forcing it to `false` reds **5** — the control proving the instrument moves both ways, so the 4 above are a reading and not a dead mutation. ⇒ the existence check IS load-bearing where a subpath has no module form, and is kept there.

## The two-way reproduction, before and after

Exit codes captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`).

| tree state | BEFORE (`3bc1bb4903`) | AFTER (`5b95531028`) |
|---|---|---|
| built (`pnpm turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'`, 39/39 tasks) | `VITEST_EXIT=1` · `Tests 1 failed \| 43 passed (44)` · `AssertionError: expected 0 to be greater than 0` | `VITEST_EXIT=0` · `Tests 46 passed (46)` |
| built, only `packages/layout/dist/index.umd.cjs` moved aside | `VITEST_EXIT=0` · `Tests 44 passed (44)` | `VITEST_EXIT=0` · `Tests 46 passed (46)` |
| fully unbuilt (all 39 `packages/*/dist` aside) | `VITEST_EXIT=0` · `Tests 44 passed (44)` | `VITEST_EXIT=0` · `Tests 46 passed (46)` |

Every move-aside restored and proven by STATE, not by an exit code — `blob=782bc790a31b9c45098d5a36c7b713f619ac307f equals pre-move ...; file exists: yes`, and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## The verdict no longer moves, but the input still does

The real-workspace probe over every form both array-declaring packages publish, run built and fully unbuilt. **After the fix, the only remaining difference is the raw `existsInPackage` reading itself** — every classification line and every `evaluate()` line is identical:

```
=== AFTER FIX: diff BUILT vs UNBUILT ===
3c3
<   subpath . · form dist/index.js · existsInPackage=true
---
>   subpath . · form dist/index.js · existsInPackage=false
10,11c10,11
<   subpath . · form dist/index.umd.cjs · existsInPackage=true
---
>   subpath . · form dist/index.umd.cjs · existsInPackage=false
```

Before the fix the same diff also carried the verdict:
```
<   ENTRY subpath=. kind=entry-point ... alternateFormats=[]
---
>   ENTRY subpath=. kind=entry-point ... alternateFormats=["dist/index.umd.cjs"]
```

⛔ That the input still moves is the point: the agreement is not "nothing was looked at".

## The gate is not dead — control with a known direction, BOTH states

A package that genuinely violates the rule must still FAIL. `@object-ui/app-shell` with one entry removed from its real array:

```
######## CONTROL [BUILT] ########          ######## CONTROL [UNBUILT] ########
   ok=false                                    ok=false
   missing=["src/console/connect/ConnectAgentWidget.tsx"]   (both)
   modulesWalked=449 registrars=14             modulesWalked=449 registrars=14
   VERDICT: HIT (gate detects the violation)   VERDICT: HIT (gate detects the violation)
CLEAN @object-ui/app-shell: ok=true missing=[] stale=[] problems=[]   (both)
CLEAN @object-ui/layout:    ok=true missing=[] stale=[] problems=[]   (both)
main([], root) = 0                             main([], root) = 0
```

⚠️ Worth recording, because it refutes a hypothesis raised in review: an unbuilt tree does **not** measure nothing. `modulesWalked` is 449 and 8, with 14 and 1 registrars, in **both** states. Roots already resolve to source — `const entryPoints = [...new Set([map.sourceBarrel, ...classification.roots])].sort();` — and `dist/index.js` short-circuits on `map.toSource(form)` before `existsInPackage` is reached. An edge that fails to resolve is loud, not dropped.

## The three cases that had to stay unchanged — measured, not predicted

Gate's own output, each fixture run in both states:

```
CASE 1 — ./ghost (dangling .js, NO module sibling)      UNBUILT: gauge=true ok=false  problems=[... cannot CLASSIFY "./dist/ghost.js" ...]
                                                          BUILT: gauge=true ok=false  problems=[... cannot CLASSIFY "./dist/ghost.js" ...]
CASE 2 — ./* subpath PATTERN                            UNBUILT: gauge=true ok=false  problems=[... cannot CLASSIFY "./dist/*.js" ...]
                                                          BUILT: gauge=true ok=false  problems=[... cannot CLASSIFY "./dist/*.js" ...]
CASE 3 — ./styles.css (real file, NO module sibling)    UNBUILT: gauge=false ok=true  entryForms=[[".","entry-point",[]],["./styles.css","asset",[]]]
                                                          BUILT: gauge=false ok=true  entryForms=[[".","entry-point",[]],["./styles.css","asset",[]]]
```

## The pin, and its ablation

Two new cases, both against one manifest run twice — with and without build output on disk. Reverting only the structural decision (restoring the `fs.existsSync`-decided single pass) reds the pin:

```
occurrences of FIXED text after : 0
occurrences of ABLATED text after: 1
matched lines on disk now:
1066:      return { form, kind: 'unmapped' };
post-mutation blob=a5d437af724ce593b47b6250778a67bd352e213d (differs from 71166ee2333697f9d4e4fba76226f4dca78a2ae1)
VITEST_EXIT=1
      Tests  2 failed | 44 passed (46)
     × classifies a second build FORMAT the same way built and unbuilt
     × finds a stylesheet subpath and a second build format, and no second entry POINT

 FAIL ... > classifies a second build FORMAT the same way built and unbuilt
AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ 'dist/index.umd.cjs' ]
restore proven by STATE: blob=71166ee2333697f9d4e4fba76226f4dca78a2ae1 == HEAD blob; git diff HEAD names: []
```

The pin asserts the alternate format is actually FOUND in both states **before** asserting the two agree — two empty sets agree with each other, so without that the pin would survive a gate that stopped classifying. Its partner case keeps a dangling form under a module-less subpath refused in both states.

## ⛔ What this GIVES UP — declared in the instrument, not only here

⚠️ **Corrected in `9fcd786c77`.** The first version of this section, and of the gate header it describes, stated the reason **backwards** — it claimed the discrimination fired "only on an unbuilt checkout". Measured base against head on one manifest whose `.` publishes an `import` half and a `require` half, the require half under test, `dist/index.js` present in every built leg:

```
REAL alternate format (umd IS produced)   [BUILT]
   base: alternateFormats=[]                        problems=0
   head: alternateFormats=["dist/index.umd.cjs"]    problems=0
DANGLING (declared, never produced)       [BUILT]
   base: alternateFormats=["dist/index.umd.cjs"]    problems=0
   head: alternateFormats=["dist/index.umd.cjs"]    problems=0
UNBUILT tree, the same pair
   base: alternateFormats=["dist/index.umd.cjs"]    problems=0   (BOTH legs — separates nothing)
   head: alternateFormats=["dist/index.umd.cjs"]    problems=0   (BOTH legs)
```

⇒ the discrimination existed **only on a BUILT tree**, where `alternateFormats` was *exactly* the dangling set because real formats existed and went to `asset`. On an unbuilt tree nothing existed, everything landed in `alternateFormats`, and the field separated nothing — which is the defect this PR fixes. The old wording named the one state where the behaviour was useless and called it the only state where it worked.

Stated accurately, and now written that way in the gate's own header:

- What is given up is **discriminating power, not visibility** — a dangling form is still **listed** in `alternateFormats`, it just no longer stands *alone* there.
- It was a **reported field, never a refusal**: `problems` is 0 in every leg above, so **nothing that used to fail now passes**.
- **The trade: a build-state-dependent verdict is exchanged for the ability to spot a dangling form that sits beside a real one.** Worth it because the former is a red a contributor cannot clear — the artefact it turned on is `.gitignore`d, so the input was not in the tree at all — and the latter was never enforced.

Unchanged, because they were already correct and are load-bearing: such a form adds **no graph root** either way (the module form under its subpath IS the root), so no registrar can hide behind it; and the bound — ⛔ **not** widened to subpaths with no module form, where `existsInPackage` still decides and removing it was measured to promote a dangling form to a root and crash the walk on ENOENT.

## Gates run locally

| gate | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-side-effects-array.test.ts` | `Tests 46 passed (46)` — built, half-built and fully unbuilt |
| `node scripts/check-side-effects-array.mjs` | `EXIT=0`, both packages ✅ |
| `scripts/__tests__/side-effects-declaration-consistency.test.ts` (sibling gate) | `Tests 32 passed (32)` |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-sdui-registration-pins.test.ts` | `Tests 15 passed (15)` |
| `pnpm run type-check:scripts` | `EXIT=0` |
| `eslint` on both changed files | `EXIT=0`, 0 errors 0 warnings |
| `check-changeset-presence` · `check-changeset-no-major` · `check-control-bytes` · `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` | all `EXIT=0` |

Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm are left to CI.

## ⚠️ One accident, fixed forward and left visible

The first commit wrote this card's changeset to `.changeset/olive-donkeys-smile.md`, which **already existed on `main`** carrying a live `@object-ui/plugin-charts: minor` note — that bump and its CHANGELOG entry would have been dropped silently. The second commit restores it byte-identical to the base and moves this card's changeset to an issue-derived filename. Net effect of the branch on `.changeset/` is one file added, none modified. Not amended away, so the accident stays auditable.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— `scripts/check-side-effects-array.mjs` 里判断「这个发布形态是不是同一个入口的第二种构建格式」时,改成读 manifest 自己的 subpath 结构,不再问文件系统。`existsInPackage` 一行没动,两个调用点都在。

**为什么改** —— 这条判断原先靠 `fs.existsSync`,而它依赖的那个文件 `packages/layout/dist/index.umd.cjs` 是 `.gitignore` 掉的。结果:构建过 workspace 的贡献者跑 `scripts/__tests__/` 会拿到一个**自己的 diff 永远清不掉的红**,断言消息 `expected 0 to be greater than 0` 又不含任何可搜索的词。CI 看不见(跑这个门禁的 job 装依赖但不构建),所以没有东西因此发出去 —— 代价是它训练所有人忽略这个目录下的红。这是该类问题在本仓的第 3 个实测实例。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 这笔交易一句话:**用「判决不再取决于构建状态」换掉「认出一个挨着真实格式的悬空声明」**。放弃的那半边只在**构建过的树上**才有分辨力(那时真实格式落到 `asset`,`alternateFormats` 里剩下的恰好就是悬空的那个);未构建的树上什么都不存在、全落进 `alternateFormats`,分辨力为零 —— 而那正是本 PR 要修的。换来的那半边是:构建过 workspace 的贡献者不再拿到一个自己清不掉的红。⚠️ 而且放弃的不是可见性:悬空形态**仍然列在** `alternateFormats` 里,只是不再单独站在那儿;`problems` 始终为 0,这从来不是一道拒绝,**没有任何原本会失败的东西现在通过了**。已写进门禁文件头部,不是静默缺口。没有 module 兄弟的 subpath 上,检测原样保留。回滚:`git revert`,三个 commit,无数据迁移、无发布影响(changeset 是空 frontmatter,不发版)。

**席位意见** ——

**你要做的** —— 看一眼门禁头部新增的「DECLINES to detect」那一节,确认这个取舍你接受;那是本 PR 唯一需要人来裁的东西。
